title: Routes
subtitle: Planned routes you imported or saved from your activities

empty.title: No routes yet
empty.description: Import a GPX, TCX or FIT file, or save one of your activities as a route.

error.title: Couldn't load routes
error.description: Something went wrong while loading your routes.

detail.notFoundDescription: This route doesn't exist or you can't see it.
detail.noElevation: This route has no elevation data.
detail.sharedNotFound: This link is invalid, was revoked, or public links are turned off.
detail.endpointsHidden: The creator hid the start and end of this route.

import.title: Import routes
import.description: Choose one or more GPX, TCX or FIT files. Each file becomes a route.

share.title: Share route
share.description: Choose who can see this route and how much of it they see.

visibility.label: Who can see this route
visibility.publicHint: Everyone on this server, and anyone on the web if public links are on.
visibility.privateHint: Only you, plus anyone you send a link to.

hideEndpoints.label: Hide start and end
hideEndpoints.hint: Others see the route without this distance at each end, including downloads and copies.

link.title: Link
link.hint: Anyone with the link can view and download the route, whatever its visibility. Links work only when the server allows public links.

homeWarning.start: This route starts near where many of your activities start, which may reveal where you live. Consider hiding the start and end.
homeWarning.end: This route ends near where many of your activities start, which may reveal where you live. Consider hiding the start and end.
homeWarning.both: This route starts and ends near where many of your activities start, which may reveal where you live. Consider hiding the start and end.

profile.ownEmptyDescription: Routes you import or save appear here. Others see only the ones you share.
